_comment: Constants that are NOT data-tuned must each cite a reference (ref_key). Anything without a solid citation is moved to a sensitivity sweep (see *_sensitivity arrays). Verify every ref in the Stage-F integrity pass before it enters the manuscript.

diesel_pump_annual_fuel_litres._comment: litres/diesel-pump/yr; no single authoritative value -> SWEEP. Cite NSSO/AISI pump-use surveys if a value is adopted.

pump_energy_kWh_per_m3_per_m_lift._comment: specific energy for groundwater lift; scale by district/state water-table depth.

ccts_carbon_price_scenarios_INR_per_tCO2._comment: CCTS market opens ~Oct 2026; no realized prices yet -> scenario distributions, not point values.

kusum_back_cast_rule._comment: Treatment series construction is a sensitivity dimension; report main + alternatives.
